'''Murgoob's lair''' was the home of the reclusive [[Dulok oracle]], [[Murgoob]]. The abode was constructed from a hollowed out tree stump. It had several windows and a door at its entrance. The lair was located in a swampy region near the [[Dulok Swamp]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Murgoob rarely ventured from his home, and when visitors came to seek his counsel, his advice was punctuated by pillars of gray smoke shooting from his lair's windows and roof.
